spec.name: M6.Flatten.flatten_left
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Flatten.unflatten N (M6.Flatten.flatten N z) = z
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Ext both function blocks; ZMod.val_lt, cast_val, Nat.add_sub_cancel. First branch i.val<N, second N+i.val≥N. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.flatten_right
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Flatten.unflatten N v) = v
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Ext i, split i.val<N; cast residue val=i or i-N by val_natCast and mod_eq_of_lt; Fin.ext, omega. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.flatten_add
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (z w : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Flatten.flatten N (z+w) = M6.Flatten.flatten N z + M6.Flatten.flatten N w
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Ext coordinate and split if; pointwise additions are definitionally equal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.flatten_smul
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (c : ZMod 2) (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Flatten.flatten N (c • z) = c • M6.Flatten.flatten N z
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Ext coordinate and split if; pointwise scalar multiplication. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.flatten_weight
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Pinned.weight (M6.Flatten.flatten N z) = M6.Physical.wordWeight N z
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Convert filtered card to sum of indicator, split Fin(2N) into FinN+FinN via Fin.sum_univ_add after 2*N=N+N, then finite sums FinN↔ZModN via cast. No division or support assumptions. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.flatten_dot
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z w : M6.Physical.Word N), M6.Character.dot (M6.Flatten.flatten N z) (M6.Flatten.flatten N w) = M6.Physical.pairing N z w
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Split finite sum into two halves, identify indices with ZModN using val/cast bijection, unfolds dot and pairing. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.J_involution
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), M6.Flatten.J N (M6.Flatten.J N v) = v
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Unfold J then flatten_left, Physical.J_involution, flatten_right. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.J_weight
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), M6.Pinned.weight (M6.Flatten.J N v) = M6.Pinned.weight v
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Use flatten_weight twice, actual Physical.J_weight and flatten_right. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Flatten.cycle_orthogonal
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), M6.Physical.syndrome N a b (M6.Flatten.unflatten N v) = 0 ↔ ∀ h : M6.Physical.Block N, M6.Character.dot (M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h))) v = 0
queries: Fin sum_univ_add finite sum equivalence ZMod
spec.guidance: Use Physical.cycle_orthogonal and flatten_dot with z=J boundary, w=unflattenv; flatten_right rewrites second argument. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
